issues.reason: Bare 'when P, Q' with indefinite participants routes through the whenever machinery, which prescribes the response as a Skolem event per occurrence tied to its trigger with (During <response> <trigger>) — the parse's (sk_lit $v $l) omits the blocking occurrence $b and emits no During atom at all.

gaps_confirmed: durative 'through <named period>' extent ('stay lit through winter'): During is restricted to the words during/while/throughout over a reified outer eventuality, Start/End needs from/until wording, and Measure duration needs a stated count, so only a point-like (Time e winter) is expressible and the whole-season extent force is dropped
defect_summary: The compliant form keeps the same rule but Skolemizes the lit-state on the trigger occurrence and ties it in, e.g. (sk_lit $b $l) with (During (sk_lit $b $l) $b) added to the conclusion.
notes: The rest follows the instruction set: the stay-lit continuation shape (reified state + Still + flat per-lantern atom, no tense on a generic), the passive by-phrase as Agent, the non-spatial From oblique, entity-attached LocatedIn for 'in that cove', and both compound decompositions.
